summary: BifrOSt has a 58-type table with identifiers, conformance tree, extensions, MIME mapping and descriptions, exposed to apps through the SDK. App-declared exported and imported types and a generic tag-class API exist as a host-tested registry but are not yet wired into app launch, and the Apple system type catalogue is much smaller than the official list.

features.note: conforms and distance cover the parent tree; the table has 58 types
case-insensitive; used by Files and the pasteboard

features.feature: Type from MIME type and back
features.note: wildcards such as image/* name the abstract type
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. English strings only, no localization tables

features.apple: UTTagClass and tags(), UTType.tags for other classes
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 28 tests. UtTagClass takes any class string (filename extension, MIME type, or a declared class from UTTypeTagSpecification); host unit tests only, not yet checked on Midget. No system tag classes beyond the two Apple ones

features.apple: UTExportedTypeDeclarations, UTImportedTypeDeclarations, Defining file and data types for your app
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 22 tests. [[exported_types]]/[[imported_types]] manifest blocks and UTExportedTypeDeclarations-shaped entries register into the uttype lookups (extension, MIME, conformance to public.data, description); UtType has exported_as, imported_as, filename_extension, mime_type, tag, is_declared, is_dynamic, is_public. Exported beats imported; cycles and reserved ids are refused; built-in extensions stay with the system. Host unit tests only; the shell does not call register_manifest at app launch yet, not yet checked on Midget. One MIME type per declaration is indexed

features.apple: System-declared uniform type identifiers (the Apple list on the landing page)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. covers the common images, audio, video, text, archive, code and document types; no 3D, Apple-only, Shazam or bundle types
Text, URL and file payloads have fixed or extension-derived types (headless_payload_types_* in proto/tests). Text, URL and file payloads only.

features.feature: Open and share targets by type
features.apple: Document types and handled types in Info.plist
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/sharing.rs:35 (open_types, handles); tests: springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01b.rs; springboard/sdk/src/share.rs (manifest handles); wired: springboard/src/shell/defaultapps.rs (CATEGORIES); springboard/src/shell/sharing.rs
features.note: Targets are matched by the type an item conforms to, and web links by scheme (headless_open_targets_* in springboard/tests). Receiving works from the manifest list; no per-app rank or default-handler API from the type. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 5 (0.5.43); verify on Midget for parity.

features.feature: Document read and write by type
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/document.rs:40 (Document trait: read, write, readable_types, default_type)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 20 tests. type strings are UTIs; no writable types list or conversion rules

features.feature: Conformance check for tag matching in file kind
features.note: only PNG and JPEG count as Image in the viewer, as recorded in docs/bifrost-ui.md:335
